desc: Build adjacency list from input and root the tree at 1 (compute parent and children order via iterative DFS).
Implement iterative post-order DP computing g[u], use_int[u], down0[u], down4[u], and best[u] for each node.
Sort each node’s child g-values to obtain top 3 and top 4 sums; compute max use_int among children for down0.
Use a large negative sentinel (e.g., -10**18) for impossible states; ensure g[u] = max(use_int[u], 1).
Track the global maximum of best[u] across all nodes; if it is 0, output -1, else output the maximum.
Test the implementation on the provided sample inputs and additional edge cases (N=1, star, path, etc.).
